name: Ningbo Future Era Robotics
name_zh: 宁波未来时代机器人有限公司
summary: Ningbo Future Era Robotics develops wheeled humanoid robots for industrial applications such as machining and flexible manufacturing. Its manufacturer-provided World Robot Conference profile presents industrial, heavy-duty and folding-waist humanoid platforms. The company identifies its wholly owned Shanghai Spider Robot subsidiary as its research and development center in Zhangjiang, Shanghai. Its product brochure uses the Spider Robot brand.
